howToPlay.title: How to play
howToPlay.yourRules: These pages follow the rules of your current game.

board.title: The board
board.picture: A 5 by 5 board. Each player starts in the middle of their side. The four start squares and the centre are marked with a cross.
board.body: Each player races four pawns around the outer ring, then the inner ring, to the centre. Squares marked with a cross are safe: nobody can be hit there.

throws.title: Throwing the shells
throws.body: Four cowrie shells are thrown together. Count the shells that land mouth up.
throws.extra: Chamma (4) and Ashta (8) earn another throw. Keep throwing until you get a 1, 2 or 3, then use the throws one by one.

triple.true: Three 4s or 8s in a row lose the whole turn, including the throws already made.
triple.false: There is no penalty for throwing several 4s or 8s in a row.

throws.rethrowOnOne: In this game a 1 also earns another throw.

moving.title: Moving

entry.onStart: All pawns begin on your start square.
entry.needChammaOrAshta: Your pawns wait on your start square. Use a 4 or 8 to bring one into play.

moving.body: Each throw moves one pawn (or a double) by its full value. You need the exact count to reach the centre. If no throw can be used, your turn passes.

noHit.block: Until you hit an opponent, your pawns stop at the end of the outer ring.
noHit.circle: Until you hit an opponent, your pawns keep going round the outer ring.
noHit.free: Your pawns may go on into the inner ring at any time; no hit is needed.

hits.title: Hitting
hits.body: Land on a square with one opponent pawn to send it back to its start square. A hit earns a bonus throw and opens the inner ring for all your pawns.
hits.hitNeedsEntry: In this game a hit pawn leaves the board and needs a 4 or 8 to enter again.

doubles.title: Doubles

on.blockOnce: Two of your pawns on one square make a double. Nobody can land on it, and on the outer ring opponents cannot pass it on their next turn. A double can move together.
on.free: Two of your pawns on one square make a double. Nobody can land on it, but opponents may pass it. A double can move together.

doubles.off: Your pawns may share a square, but they never block or move together. Landing on several of an opponent's pawns hits them all.

winning.title: Winning
winning.body: The first player to bring all four pawns to the centre wins.
winning.bonusOnHome: Each pawn that reaches the centre earns a bonus throw.

playToEnd.true: With 3 or 4 players, play carries on after the first winner until 2nd and 3rd place are decided.
playToEnd.false: The game ends as soon as one player has all four pawns home.

names.title: Other names
names.body: {{app}} is the game also known as Ashta Chamma, Chowka Bara, Daayam and Kanna Kauri across India.
